title: Character Skills
blurb: Every ability in the battlegrounds project, recorded per character: basic combo, four skills and an ultimate. Each clip is shown solo so the effect reads clearly, and again against a target so the impact, hit-stop and knockback land in context.

characters.name: Sosuke Aizen
characters.summary: Illusion kit built around misdirection: the clone reveal lands before the real hit does.

characters.name: Android 18
characters.summary: Energy volleys and blade throws, tuned for sustained chip damage at range.

characters.name: Baki Hanma
characters.summary: Pure hand-to-hand chain — spin kick into double hit into a committed smash.

characters.name: Beam Strike
characters.summary: Elemental ranged kit: wind spike, thunder strike and a tornado that judges the field.

characters.name: Beatrice
characters.summary: Spatial kit built on wormholes, with spikes arriving from wherever she opens one.

characters.name: Bill Cipher
characters.summary: Reality-warping set: a checkerboard slam, soot fire and a golden fist finisher.

characters.name: Ejin
characters.summary: Original design: a drill-rush opener that converts into a ground-burst finisher.

characters.name: Emilia
characters.summary: Ice control kit: rings and slides that shape the ground before the slam lands.

characters.name: Frieza
characters.summary: Precision beams and saucers, every skill built to punish from a distance.

characters.name: Gilgamesh
characters.summary: Projectile-heavy kit — the ultimate opens a full sword rain over the arena.

characters.name: Satoru Gojo
characters.summary: Red, Blue and the hollow purple finisher, each with its own charge language.

characters.name: Son Goku
characters.summary: Classic rush-down: flash step into impact, then a full energy burst.

characters.name: Gon Freecss
characters.summary: Aura orbs that launch, smash and finally rip the ground up.

characters.name: Ichigo Kurosaki
characters.summary: Crescent slashes and Getsuga arcs, all reading off one blade trail system.

characters.name: Kaguya Otsutsuki
characters.summary: Portal-based kit: strikes arrive from somewhere other than where she stands.

characters.name: Monkey D. Luffy
characters.summary: Stretch attacks with a Gear Second state that re-times the whole kit.

characters.name: Madara Uchiha
characters.summary: Fire annihilation and clones, with a Sharingan opener that sets up the rest.

characters.name: Naruto Uzumaki
characters.summary: Shadow-clone kit — every skill spawns, strikes with, and despawns clones.

characters.name: Natsu Dragneel
characters.summary: Fire dragon kit, from flame kick to a full-cone dragon roar.

characters.name: Saitama
characters.summary: The joke is the design: ordinary punches that escalate to a serious smash.

characters.name: Sasuke Uchiha
characters.summary: Fire and lightning in one kit — Chidori current closes the gap.

characters.name: Steroid Man
characters.summary: Two heavy commitments - the ground rapture opens the arena, venom rush fills it.

characters.name: Ryomen Sukuna
characters.summary: Heaviest kit in the set; the ultimate is the longest sequence recorded.

characters.name: Tanjiro Kamado
characters.summary: Breathing forms — water surface and whirlpool share one flowing trail shader.

characters.name: Vegeta
characters.summary: Barrage into Final Flash — the kit builds to one committed beam.

characters.name: Yoriichi Tsugikuni
characters.summary: Sun breathing: blazing rush and storm field layered over one trail system.

characters.name: Yuji Itadori
characters.summary: Charged fists leading into Black Flash, the kit's one high-impact beat.

characters.name: Balanced I
characters.summary: Starter archetype used to tune baseline damage and cooldown pacing.

characters.name: Balanced II
characters.summary: Second balanced preset: a slower wind-up traded for a wider blast.

characters.name: Healer
characters.summary: Support preset — the healing wave drove the buff/aura VFX language.

characters.name: Ranger I
characters.summary: Ranged preset: fireball barrage used to tune projectile spacing.

characters.name: Ranger II
characters.summary: Sustained-beam variant of the ranger archetype.

characters.name: Ranger III
characters.summary: Burst variant — triple shot with a tighter spread.

characters.name: Tank Soldier I
characters.summary: Tank preset: ground slam used to tune knockback and screen shake.

characters.name: Tank Soldier II
characters.summary: Heavy single-target punch variant of the tank archetype.

characters.name: Tank Soldier III
characters.summary: Area-denial variant — earth breaker with a wide impact ring.

characters.name: Tank Soldier IV
characters.summary: Mobility tank: phantom dash closes distance before the slam.
